reason: Provides model-callable stage gates for multi-phase agent work by managing acceptance checklists and producing PASS or BLOCK conclusions using session-scoped in-memory state.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的多阶段智能体工作提供可调用的阶段门工具，用于管理验收清单并生成通过或阻塞结论。
summaries.en: Provides callable stage-gate tools for multi-phase agent work in DeepSeek Harness, managing acceptance checklists and producing pass or block conclusions.

capabilities: Registers model-callable tools for opening, checking, listing, and closing stage gates
Maintains in-memory gate lifecycle state scoped to an agent session
Evaluates checklist items and returns passed or blocked conclusions
